attr.title: Mario Strikers Charged
attr.desc: A native port of Mario Strikers Charged, the rough and tumble five a side football game from the Wii, built from the community decompilation of the game and run on an OpenGL ES 3 renderer. You need your own USA disc image of the game.
attr.inst: Dump your own Mario Strikers Charged USA disc (game ID R4QE01, revision 1) and copy the .rvz or .iso file into ports/mscharged/. The disc image is read directly, nothing has to be extracted or converted.
